needed.evidence: footway is too narrow and unusable, people walking in the road
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the left sidewalk to at least 1.5 metres width and ensure it is clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: footway obstruction from carts and vehicles parked on or near the footpath
needed.suggestion: Set up clear footpath signs and enforce regulations to keep the right sidewalk free from obstruction.

needed.evidence: uneven surface hazard on the footpath
needed.suggestion: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: marked pedestrian crossing with poor visibility and no proper kerb ramps
needed.suggestion: Install adequate signalized crossing with a refuge island to improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: lack of driver compliance and inadequate marking
needed.suggestion: Create a raised platform and improve markings at the pedestrian crossing.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs to ensure smooth transitions at the marked pedestrian crossing.
